description: Edition 2021 match ergonomics make ref/ref mut in if-let patterns non-idiomatic. Affected: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs (2 sites), pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs (1 site), pkix-path/src/lib.rs (8+ sites). Replace 'if let Some(ref x) = foo' with 'if let Some(x) = &foo'.
title: refactor: replace ref/ref mut in if-let patterns with & on scrutinee
